scope: Eighteen privacy-edited historical reports from six anonymous submission sources across the 2021 and 2025 course offerings.
role: Preserved original learning material with identity-only privacy edits. Reports may document buggy or incomplete historical programs.
attribution_note: A report records its own anonymous source; the archive does not infer source-code authorship from a report folder or filename.
